description: This file contains test routines for checking protocol disabling in Git, including functions to test clone/fetch/push operations with different environment variables and configuration settings related to protocol allowance. It sets up wrappers for SSH and remote access used during testing.

methods.name: test_allow_var
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, and push operations with GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL environment variable set for specific protocols.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Tests clone, fetch, and push operations with protocol.allow configuration and related environment variables.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Runs comprehensive tests for a specific protocol, combining environment variable and configuration checks.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up an SSH wrapper script to intercept SSH commands during testing.

methods.name: setup_ext_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a wrapper for remote extension testing, facilitating remote repository access simulation.
